answer: A proof-of-personhood oracle linked to each seat is the mechanism: to become many agents, a sybil farmer must pass an independent attestation, not just spawn keys. Suppose one real person vouches for each new agent and forfeits a bond if it is caught twinning another. The attacker's delta in identities now costs a bonded voucher per fake seat, and near-duplicate answers get matched, so copying an honest orchard of outputs still burns bonds. Fresh work must be produced and vouched for at a harbor of real humans, making large-scale sybils linear in bond cost and economically pointless.
